title: Manager touchpoint slate — prep & actions (Juliette Cole)
content:
Context:
- Weekly upward 1:1 with report (Samir) — quick sync, unblock, career, align on priorities for next sprint. Keep to 30 min.
- Focus: shipping stable quantized runtime for v0.9, ramp plan for Dedicated pool, and PR backlog triage.
- Tone: coaching + concrete unblock. Start with wins, then friction, then career & asks.

Recent signals to surface:
- Metrics: average PR lead time down to 2.9 days (goal 2.5), e2e latency p95 regressed from 220ms -> 290ms after recent kernel change (INF-3567).
- Customer incident: dedicated-customer "Nimbus" saw higher tail latency — routing fallback triggered twice last week. Ops blameless postmortem in progress.
- Staffing: backend hire delayed 3 weeks (offer accepted but start shifted). Impact on v0.9 test coverage.

Top agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins & highlights (3m)
   - Ask Samir: what went well since last sync? one quick metric or demo.
2) Current blockers (8m)
   - Kernel latency regression (INF-3567) — status, repro, temporary mitigation (roll back vs hotfix).
   - Test infra flakiness for quantized builds — need triage owner? (note: assign QA lead if not resolved).
3) Priorities alignment (8m)
   - v0.9 ship criteria: define must-have vs nice-to-have for this sprint.
   - Dedicated pool ramp: confirm schedule for capacity add and canary plan.
4) Career & signals (5m)
   - Ask about growth areas: ownership, cross-team influence. Prepare a stretch task suggestion (lead kernel perf spike RCA + doc).
5) Actions & commitments (6m)
   - Capture owners, deadlines, and follow-ups. Confirm sync cadence and next check-in.

Key discussion prompts (script snippets):
- "Start — quick win: what's one thing you're proud of this week?"
- "Blocker check — which of these is highest pain right now and why?"
- "If we could remove one meeting/priority to buy you a week of deep time, which would it be?"
- "For career progress: what would success look like in 3 months?"

Notes to self / signals to watch during the sync:
- If Samir mentions context switching, raise ability to block calendar for 6-8h heads-down sessions.
- Probe for morale: language like "frustrating" vs "expected" — escalate if strong negative.
- If he asks for help with prioritization, be ready to suggest de-prioritizing non-customer-facing infra work for 2 sprints.

Current open items I want updates on before we close: (make sure to capture owners)
- INF-3567 kernel regression: repro steps, suspected commit, temporary rollback decision (owner: Samir) — due EOD tomorrow.
- PR backlog for serving-runtime: triage plan and assign owners for 8 high-priority PRs (owner: Samir + Hiro) — due Mon next week.
- Dedicated ramp checklist: confirm capacity test window + SLA smoke tests (owner: Platform Eng) — request confirmation by Wed.
- QA flaky tests: identify top 5 flakiest suites and assign triage (owner: QA lead) — due Fri.

Suggested action items (capture in tasks during meeting):
- Samir: open a short ticket summarizing repro + experimental rollback plan for INF-3567 (linked to JIRA) — due 2027-06-16.
- Me (Juliette): escalate capacity concern to Product + Ops, ask for formal canary dates — due 2027-06-17.
- Hiro: run perf profile on nightly quantized builds and share flamegraphs — due 2027-06-18.
- Samir + QA: pair to reduce test flakiness; schedule 2-hour pairing session this week — due 2027-06-18.

Career checkpoint (notes to discuss):
- Progress: shipping lead on v0.8 kernel optimizations and mentoring two ICs on perf tooling.
- Growth ask from Samir last month: larger scope project & stakeholder comms.
- Suggestion: sponsor him to lead v0.9 ship retro + a short doc for cross-team rollout lessons learned (concrete deliverable).

Feedback I want to give (gentle + specific):
- "You've done a good job owning the v0.8 rollback and keeping customer comms tight — would like to see you push status earlier when latency trends start to increase."
- Offer concrete habit: post a 2-line daily signal in #serving-runtime-channel when tail latency spikes >15% vs baseline.

Follow-ups after meeting (template to send in Slack/email):
- Quick recap lines: wins, 3 blockers, actions with owners & due dates, ask for confirmation.
- Request: drop relevant logs/links into the JIRA ticket and tag me.

Potential risks to flag to leadership if unresolved after next sync:
- v0.9 slip >1 sprint due to test infra + hire delay. Impact: Dedicated customers depend on v0.9 perf uplift; could require capacity credits/credits and PR for SLA concessions.
- Regressing tail latency causing degraded UX for streaming workloads — escalate to SRE + Product if we can't narrow root cause in 48h.

Loose end ideas / brain dump (not for meeting unless time):
- Build a short "canary checklist" doc template that product & SRE can use for every Dedicated rollout.
- Propose a spike: 3-day perf blitz dedicated to quantized path with a rotating small team and a strict scope.
- Mentorship idea: pair Samir with a senior infra PM for stakeholder comms practice.

Meeting close script (to confirm next steps):
- "Ok summarizing: Samir will take INF-3567 repro + rollback ticket (due tomorrow), Hiro to run perf profile (Thu), I will escalate capacity dates to product (Fri). Any other immediate asks? Great — I'll follow up with a short recap message after this call."

Quick checklist before join:
- Open INF-3567 on screen, have latest p95/p99 chart, PR list filtered to 'ready for review', and the proposed v0.9 ship criteria doc.
- Slack draft for post-meeting recap ready to paste.

Version notes:
- This is a scratchpad — move confirmed actions to my personal tasks and JIRA after the meeting.
